name: block
description:
The **Hero Section** block (registered as `example/hero`) is a layout‑type block introduced with API version 3 and represented in the editor by the “cover” icon. Its purpose is to provide a full‑width hero area that can showcase a background image, a headline, a supporting paragraph, and a call‑to‑action button. The block is described as “A full‑width hero section with background image, title, and call‑to‑action button,” and it can be discovered through the keywords “hero,” “banner,” and “call to action.”  

This block defines several attributes: a `backgroundImage` (string, default empty), a `title` (HTML source, selector `h2`, default “Welcome to Our Site”), a `subtitle` (HTML source, selector `p`, default “We are glad you are here.”), a `buttonText` (default “Learn More”), a `buttonUrl` (default “#”), and an `align` setting (default “full”). It supports alignment options “wide” and “full,” background and text color customisation, and margin and padding spacing, while direct HTML editing is disabled. Two style variations are available: the default style labeled “Default” (pre‑selected) and an alternative “Dark” style. For illustration, an example configuration sets the title to “Welcome to Our Site,” the subtitle to “We are glad you are here,” uses the background image `https://example.com/hero.jpg`, and configures the button with the text “Learn More” linking to `https://example.com/about`.
